{{Quote|So uncivilized.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''DT-57 "Annihilator" blaster''' was a high-powered [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] manufactured during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Highly customizable, the DT-57 featured a high output blaster magazine, a large trigger guard and a top-mounted scope.

==History==
[[File:Grievous_blaster.png|thumb|left|250px|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] with his custom DT-57, [[Grievance Striker/Legends|Grievance Striker]].]]
During the Clone Wars, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] wielded a custom DT-57 "Annihilator", dubbed "[[Grievance Striker/Legends|Grievance Striker]],"<ref name="TSoGGLoW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref> in conjunction with the many [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] of his personal collection, stolen from Jedi he had defeated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]]. The weapon was turned on its owner when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used it to kill Grievous on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="RotS" /> The blaster was later recovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and given to [[N-K Necrosis]]. When Necrosis was destroyed by a group of spacers on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the blaster fell into their possession.<ref name="TSoGGLoW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Falsta]] carried a heavily modified Clone Wars-era DT-57 heavy blaster pistol which he claimed was once owned by General Grievous.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
